inference: Two-sided one-sample Student t test of seed-level paired contrasts against zero; df=11; nominal 95% t CI.
multiplicity: Holm across H1-H4 only, alpha=0.05; separate from original 36-test family.
interaction: Pairwise difference-of-differences averaged over remaining factor; three-way third difference. Not regression coefficients.
conditional_loss: A111 minus variant with specified single factor disabled.
sensitivity: All 4096 seed sign flips, two-sided mean statistic under symmetric independent seed contrasts; leave-one-seed-out mean ranges; sign counts.
secondary: All other cells, all interactions, canopy, other outcomes: descriptive effects and nominal CIs; no confirmatory significance claim.
missing: Preserve error record; identical case retry only; never replace seed. No complete formal inference until all 864 cases pass.
zero_variance: All-zero differences: CI [0,0], p=1; deterministic nonzero differences: explicitly marked, no finite t inference.
engineering: No new meaningful-effect or equivalence margin; nonsignificance is not equivalence.
